title: CryptoEscondido
tagline: We are looking to build a platform for whistleblowers on $DERO called #CryptoEscondido.  I think having encryption on the base layer is critical for success of the project!
description:
This is the idea of CryptoEscondido, blow the whistle for Public Good with Retroactive Fund, all with the psuedonimity of cryptocurrency.

The purpose of our project is to allow corporate whistleblowers to upload sensitive information anonymously as metadata which can then be purchased from the minter/uploader in the connected marketplace.
how_its_made:
Our project was built on Polygon chain using Moralis, Solidity, IPFS, Next.js, and a handful of awesome libraries.  The first screen our users see is a standard Wallet connect button.  We require our users be logged in to their crytpo wallet before accessing our NFT Market features.

Users should upload the cover page of their document in JPEG format.  The description input is where our users would paste the text from their document.  When the Mint button is clicked the cover image as well as the full description are uploaded to IPFS, and stored in our Moralis database.  Once the transactions are completed, the document is minted, listed, and available on our marketplace page.
